item.title: Street lights not working again, 23rd September
item.description:
No lights in Chester Gardens again! UK Power Networks visited yesterday and fixed it. The lights came on as expected at sunset set but at 1am the lights all went off again. No lights again tonight (Wednesday SIX nights now in pitch blackness When is this going to be resolved? Vulnerable residents are afraid to go out after dark.

item.title: The main street sign is missing, 23rd September
item.description:
The street-name sign for Cadet Drive at the entrance to Cadet Drive, where it joins Lynton Road, is missing. I noticed today that the sign has disappeared. I am not sure whether it has been removed because it was damaged/broken or whether it has been vandalised. Please could Southwark Council inspect the location and arrange for the Cadet Drive street-name sign to be replaced? The missing sign is at the main entrance to Cadet Drive from Lynton Road.
